newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Metkor sells 27 pct stake in Usko.
newsitem.headline: Metkor sells 27 pct stake in Usko.

text.p: South African electrical conductor firm, Usko Ltd, said on Wednesday that Metkor Group Ltd had sold its 27.3 percent stake in the firm.

Usko said in a statement that the Rembrandt Group Ltd unit had sold the holding to funds under the management of Capital Partners Ltd, Fedsure Asset Management, Genbel Securities Ltd and John Beck for 38 cents a share cash, with effect from May 30.
The board of the company has been reconstituted with Neill Davies appointed acting chairman and Beck as chief executive.
The transaction has not resulted in a change of control of the company and no offer will be made to minorities, the company added.
Usko shares have gained ground in heavy dealings in recent days on speculation of a takeover.
